SRT.Manager.Title: Sephral's Roll Triggers
SRT.Manager.Summary: Build lightweight house-rule reactions for standout rolls without replacing your system's own resolution flow.
SRT.Manager.TriggerPanelHint: Create, duplicate, import, and fine-tune the reactions that should fire when a roll matches.
SRT.Manager.InternalProfilesHint: Built-in presets are available as templates and will later be importable from the manager.
SRT.Manager.ProfilePanelHint: Keep reusable trigger bundles beside live world triggers and move them with their own JSON workflow.
SRT.Manager.EmptyProfiles: Import a profile JSON or keep using the built-in presets.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerName: Internal name for this trigger. Example: Natural 20 on attack.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerDescription: Optional summary shown in the manager. Example: Posts a crit message and rolls a table.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerCategory: Free text grouping for your own organization. Example: combat, house-rule, social.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerPriority: Higher numbers run first when multiple triggers match. Example: 200 beats 100.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerExecutionMode: Choose whether the trigger runs automatically, asks the GM, or appears as a chat button.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerMatchType: Defines what kind of dice result or system state should activate the trigger. Example: die maximum or total above threshold.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerFaces: Restrict the match to dice with this many faces. Leave it empty to check every die. Example: 20 for d20 or 6 for d6.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerValue: Specific die result to look for. Example: 1 for a fumble or 20 for a natural 20.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerThreshold: Numeric cutoff used by above or below checks. Example: 15 means strictly greater than 15.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerMinCount: Minimum number of dice that must satisfy the condition. Example: 2 for doubles.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerDegree: Success degree to match: critical-success, success, failure, or critical-failure. PF2e outcomes such as criticalSuccess or degree 3 are recognized automatically.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerPath: System flag path that must exist on the roll event. Example: dnd5e.critical.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerExpression: JavaScript expression evaluated on the GM client against event. Example: event.total >= 18 && event.rollType === "attack".
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerExtraMatch: This condition must also be true for the same roll. Each condition checks the whole roll on its own.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerExtraMatchAdd: Add a further condition. The trigger only fires when the main match and every added condition are true for the same roll. Example: one die shows 1 AND one die shows 2.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerExtraMatchRemove: Remove this AND condition from the trigger.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerRollTypes: Optional roll type filter. Example: attack, check, damage, or any.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerActorTypes: Optional actor type filter. Example: PC only, NPC only, or any actor.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerVisibilityFilter: Restrict matching to a roll visibility. Example: public only or blind only.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerCombatState: Restrict the trigger to combat or non-combat scenes.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerIncludeScenes: Only allow triggers from this scene. Example: limit a trap trigger to one dungeon scene.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerIncludeActors: Only allow triggers from this actor. Example: a cursed weapon trigger for one NPC.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerIncludeItems: Only allow triggers when this item is involved. Example: a specific sword or spell item.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerPlayerOnly: Only non-GM users can trigger this rule.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerGmOnly: Only the GM can trigger this rule.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerActionType: Choose what happens after a match. Example: chat message, roll table, macro, or journal link.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerActionVisibility: Controls who sees the action result. Example: public, GM whisper, or affected player.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerChatTemplate: Text template posted when the action runs. Example: Critical hit! Roll on the table.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerTables: Comma-separated roll table ids or uuids. Example: crit-table, RollTable.world.fumbles.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerMacro: Macro to execute when the trigger fires. Example: Apply Critical Effect.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerJournal: Journal entry to link in chat. Example: house-rule notes or injury rules.
SRT.Notification.NoActiveGm: No GM is online to run this trigger.
SRT.Import.Invalid: The selected file does not contain a valid roll-trigger export.
SRT.Import.InvalidProfiles: The selected file does not contain a valid roll-trigger profile export.
SRT.Match.AtLeastNValue: At least N dice show a specific value
SRT.Match.AtLeastNMin: At least N dice show minimum
SRT.Match.AtLeastNMax: At least N dice show maximum
SRT.Match.AllSame: All dice of a type show the same value
SRT.Match.AtLeastNSame: At least N dice of a type show the same value
SRT.Match.DieResultAbove: A die result is above a threshold
SRT.Match.DieResultBelow: A die result is below a threshold
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerSound: Sound file to play. Example: sounds/notify.wav.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerEffectStatus: Status or condition from your game system. Example: Prone.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerEffectUuid: Used when no status is chosen. Copies an existing effect, for example from an item. Example: Item.abc123.ActiveEffect.def456.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerEffectRounds: Optional. The effect ends after this many combat rounds. Empty means no duration.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerEffectTarget: The actor who rolled, or every token the roller targeted.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerResourcePath: Attribute of the rolling actor, starting with system. Examples: system.attributes.inspiration (D&D 5e), system.bennies.value (Savage Worlds), system.resources.heroism.value (Crucible).
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerResourceOperation: Add to the value, subtract from it or replace it. Values with a maximum stay between 0 and the maximum.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerResourceValue: A number or a placeholder. Example: 1 or {{roll.total}}.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerImage: Image or video shown in a popout window. Example: worlds/my-world/fumble.webp.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerImageCaption: Optional text below the image. Placeholders such as {{actor.name}} work.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerRollFormula: Formula rolled to chat. Placeholders work. Example: 1d10 for a fumble table die.
SRT.DialogHint.TriggerRollFlavor: Optional text above the roll. Placeholders such as {{actor.name}} work.
SRT.Validation.VolumeRange: Action {slot}: the volume must be between 0 and 100.
SRT.Validation.EffectMissing: Action {slot}: choose a status or enter an effect UUID.
SRT.Validation.StatusUnknown: Action {slot}: this status does not exist in the current game system.
SRT.Validation.RoundsInvalid: Action {slot}: the duration must be a whole number of rounds, at least 1.
SRT.Validation.ResourcePath: Action {slot}: the attribute path must start with system., for example system.attributes.inspiration.
SRT.Validation.ResourceValueInvalid: Action {slot}: the value must be a number or a placeholder.
SRT.Validation.FormulaInvalid: Action {slot}: this formula cannot be rolled.
SRT.TestBench.Title: Test triggers
SRT.TestBench.Intro: Try a roll and see which triggers would fire and why. Nothing runs and nothing is posted unless you choose to.
SRT.TestBench.ModuleDisabled: Roll triggers are switched off in the settings. Real rolls fire nothing right now.
SRT.TestBench.DiceHint: Set the face of each die. Leave a die empty to roll it.
SRT.TestBench.DiceNone: This formula has no dice to set.
SRT.TestBench.DiceLimit: Only the first {count} dice can be set. The rest are rolled.
SRT.TestBench.RollToChatHint: Posts a real roll with these dice, so triggers fire as in play. Combat and the roller are the real ones.
SRT.TestBench.RunActionsHint: Runs the actions of the matching triggers now. Messages, sounds and changes to actors really happen.
SRT.TestBench.RunConfirmContent: Run the actions of {count} matching triggers now? This really changes your game.
SRT.TestBench.InvalidDie: A d{faces} can only show a whole number from 1 to {faces}.
SRT.TestBench.Empty: Click Simulate to test a roll.
SRT.TestBench.NoTriggers: This world has no triggers yet.
SRT.TestBench.ReasonStopped: Not checked because {name} matched first and stops triggers with a lower priority.
SRT.TestBench.ReasonError: A condition failed with an error: {error}
SRT.TestBench.OverLimit: Would be skipped: more than {max} actions for one chat message.
SRT.TestBench.NoActions: Has no actions, so nothing happens. Add actions in the trigger editor.
SRT.TestBench.Mode.ChatButton: Shows a button on the chat message
SRT.TestBench.Mode.GmWhisperLog: Only tells the GMs, no actions run
SRT.TestBench.Mode.Disabled: Execution mode is disabled, nothing runs
